topic: Declining extended warranties and self funding repairs vs buying every warranty (Colton vs Imani)

scenes.narration: The warranties cost more than every repair he ever needed. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding two clipboards labeled BUY THE WARRANTY and BUILD A REPAIR FUND, comic burst banner reads WARRANTIES COST MORE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Colton and Imani buy the same laptop, phone, and television.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man colton and woman imani holding matching boxes labeled LAPTOP PHONE TELEVISION, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Every cashier offers them an extended warranty at the register.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a cashier sliding a paper stamped EXTENDED WARRANTY toward colton and imani at a counter, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Colton says yes each time, feeling safer for the money.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, colton nodding as three warranty papers stack up, each stamped PROTECTED, a nervous smile, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Three warranties cost him four hundred fifty dollars in total.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, colton straining under a barbell with plates stamped ONE FIFTY each, total tag FOUR HUNDRED FIFTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Imani declines and moves that money into a repair fund.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, imani waving off a warranty paper while dropping bills into a locker labeled REPAIR FUND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her card already includes one free year of purchase protection.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, imani holding a card beside a shield labeled FREE PURCHASE PROTECTION ONE YEAR, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Manufacturer warranties already cover the first year of real defects.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, imani reading a manual page stamped MANUFACTURER WARRANTY ONE YEAR on a gym bench, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Colton's television broke in year four, outside every warranty window.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, colton beside a cracked television, a calendar stamped YEAR FOUR and a paper marked EXPIRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He paid two hundred repairing it, plus four fifty for coverage.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, colton on a gym scale, one side stamped TWO HUNDRED REPAIR the other FOUR FIFTY WARRANTIES, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Imani's repair fund now holds six hundred dollars for anything.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, imani flexing beside an open locker of bills labeled REPAIR FUND SIX HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Decline the warranty and bank the money as repairs. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym, holding a clipboard reading SELF INSURE SMALL STUFF, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
